findings.evidence: Retry classifier defaults unknown (non-`*terror.Error`) errors to retryable: `pkg/ddl/index.go:1284`. Dist backfill executor uses it for subtask retries: `pkg/ddl/backfilling_dist_executor.go:224`. Framework behavior: retryable errors do not transition subtask to failed/canceled (`pkg/disttask/framework/taskexecutor/task_executor.go:616`), and executors re-check/run subtasks every 300ms (`pkg/disttask/framework/taskexecutor/manager.go:42`). This also overrides Lightning’s explicit non-retryable cases like DiskSpaceNotEnough (`pkg/lightning/common/retry.go:150`). The updated test switches `mockResetEngineFailed` to `1*return` and expects success (`tests/realtikvtest/addindextest3/ingest_test.go:542`), implying persistent failures would otherwise spin rather than fail fast.
findings.fix: Split retry policy for disttask: keep `common.IsRetryableError(err)` and add only targeted extensions (`dbterror.ReorgRetryableErrCodes` + `dbterror.ReorgRetryableErrMsgs`) but do NOT default to retry for unknown errors; or keep broad retry but add a bounded retry budget/backoff and fail the subtask/task after N attempts / elapsed time to avoid infinite running-state loops.
findings.impact: In disttask add-index mode, persistent non-`*terror.Error` errors (e.g., TiKV gRPC Unknown non-retryable conditions, local IO/permission/disk errors, unexpected internal errors) can cause hot-loop retries + log spam and an add-index DDL job that never completes nor fails, requiring manual intervention/cancellation and potentially consuming cluster resources.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked upstream/master at `f0813a369666ac6314e76f5e573e982fe50c8a09`: `pkg/ddl/backfilling_dist_executor.go` still uses `common.IsRetryableError(err) || isRetryableError(err)`, and `pkg/ddl/index.go` still returns retryable for non-`*terror.Error` errors (same semantics), so this behavior remains.
findings.verify: In disttask mode, enable failpoint `github.com/pingcap/tidb/pkg/ddl/ingest/mockResetEngineFailed` with `return` (always) and confirm the global task/subtask transitions to failed (or stops after bounded retries) instead of retrying forever. Also inject/observe a TiKV DiskSpaceNotEnough gRPC error and confirm it is treated non-retryable (subtask failed, scheduler reverts task, DDL surfaces error).
findings.what: Dist add-index disttask now retries nearly all non-`*terror.Error` errors (unknown errors default to retryable), which can keep subtasks in running state indefinitely (no retry budget) and leave DDL jobs stuck waiting for the global task on persistent infra/logic errors.

subject: ddl: add `lease not found` and `deadline exceed` to retryable errors (#56630)
summary: Adds message-based retry matching (`context deadline exceeded`, `requested lease not found`) and reuses a shared DDL retry helper across add-index + disttask backfill. Main risk: disttask backfill now treats all non-`*terror.Error` errors as retryable, overriding Lightning’s non-retryable classifications (e.g., DiskSpaceNotEnough) and enabling unbounded hot-loop retries that can leave add-index jobs stuck indefinitely; still present on upstream/master.
